name: Warm illustrated choices
art: The original character is site/assets/expansion/editorial/peeking-bird.png. Inspect its placement and the three card surfaces in the implementation; keep the illustration at this supporting scale.

properties.label: Three substantial onboarding choices
properties.text: Place three substantial onboarding choice cards beneath a short welcoming heading and compact mode selector; give each a title, clear promise, concise checklist and choice action, with a small character peeking over the row.

properties.label: Warm editorial choice hierarchy
properties.text: Use dark brown editorial type with a concise, clearly stepped hierarchy from welcome to title, promise, checklist and action.

properties.label: Ivory, burgundy and warm pink
properties.text: Use warm ivory and burgundy with carefully tuned pink and cream surfaces.

properties.label: Peeking clay bird character
properties.text: Use a small original bird with clay-like volume, eyes, feathers and a grounded overlap at the top of the choice row; keep it supporting rather than dominant.

properties.label: Restrained warm card surfaces
properties.text: Give the cards fine borders, controlled corner radii and barely lifted downward shadows, using small warm tonal steps rather than a strong border.

properties.label: Coherent Explore, Specify, Build states
properties.text: Make Explore, Specify and Build real keyboard- and touch-operable choices. The chosen card reads through a distinct warm surface, label and action, and updates title, explanation and outcome together without moving the whole layout.

properties.label: Illustrated-choice acceptance
properties.text: Keep every choice and the outcome visible on mobile, and reject a beige-card substitute with generic outline icons for the supporting illustration.
